messages:
molly: Hey @devex — opened a small PR to tighten the Python quickstart auth sample and add a streaming snippet. Can someone take a look? Prefer to merge before Wed's product demo if possible. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

kai: On it, I can do a pass in ~1h. Quick note from a glance: the streaming example is still using the older callback-style signature. We should update to the context-manager style we recommend now.

aditya: Also flag: we don't show any handling of auth errors in the sample. If the token expires the snippet will look like it just fails — worth adding a short note or an example of a refresh pattern. A tiny docs-test could catch that edge case.

molly: Good catches, thanks. I can update the snippet and add a one-liner about token refresh. Any preferences on the streaming idiom?

kai: Prefer updating to the `with client.stream(...)` pattern. Example: 
```
# old
client.stream(prompt, on_chunk=lambda c: print(c.text))

# new
with client.stream(prompt) as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.text)
```
Also please include a note to run `make docs-lint` locally before pushing — that caught the weird list indent last time.

ben: If it's just docs + small sample tweaks I'm +1. Merge after CI passes.

docs-lint-bot: docs-tests: FAILED in docs/quickstart/python/auth.md: line 42 - inconsistent indentation (MD013)

molly: Thanks — I'll push a fix in a minute: update streaming style + token refresh note + linting. Will ping when CI is green.

kai: Thanks! Happy to re-review quickly once it's pushed. Also check the code fence language `python` so syntax highlighting stays consistent.

molly: Pushed the fixes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482/commits/abc123 — ran `make docs-lint` locally, all clean. CI kicked off. :party_parrot:

ben: Nice, will keep an eye on CI. If it passes I'll merge and cherry-pick into `release/2026-03` for the demo.

aditya: Awesome — thanks for the quick turnaround.

kai: LGTM after the lint pass — thanks @molly :)

docs-lint-bot: docs-tests: PASSED

molly: CI passed and merged. Thanks everyone!
